competencies.text: discuss safety and security procedures in the music;
discuss the interdisciplinary roles and responsibilities of music artists, the functions of art organizations, and chain of accountability in the organization as an apprentice;
explain the work process involved in music production and related performing arts field;
analyze how professional, corporate social responsibility, and ethical practices can be applied in the music industry;
demonstrate proficiency, professionalism, cultural sensitivity, and ethical practices under music apprenticeship; and
synthesize the music apprenticeship experience through creative documentation.
